````cpp
#include "graph/PlanLoader.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <new>

#include "graph/PlanBlob.hpp"

#if defined(RP_DEVICE) && defined(__GLIBCXX__)
// What a device build of the loader must not carry, as graph/node.hpp checks a node's translation unit: the standard
// library's heap and exception headers (each name is its libstdc++ include guard). The device image's link trap is the
// guarantee; this is the early, readable error.
#if defined(_GLIBCXX_STRING) || defined(_GLIBCXX_VECTOR) || defined(_GLIBCXX_MAP) || defined(_GLIBCXX_OPTIONAL) || \
    defined(_GLIBCXX_STDEXCEPT) || defined(__EXCEPTION__) || defined(_GLIBCXX_IOSTREAM) ||                      \
    defined(_GLIBCXX_FUNCTIONAL) || defined(_GLIBCXX_MEMORY)
#error "the plan loader's device build includes a heap or exception header"
#endif
#endif

namespace rp::graph {

namespace {

using namespace blob;

// ---- error text ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// A sentence built into a fixed buffer, cut where it no longer fits: the loader's rp_error, with no heap.
struct Text {
    char*       out;
    std::size_t capacity;
    std::size_t length = 0;

    Text(char* buffer, std::size_t size) : out(buffer), capacity(size) { out[0] = '\0'; }
    Text& put(const char* s, std::size_t n) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n && length + 1 < capacity; ++i) out[length++] = s[i];
        out[length] = '\0';
        return *this;
    }
    Text& operator<<(const char* s) { return put(s, std::strlen(s)); }
    Text& operator<<(std::string_view s) { return put(s.data(), s.size()); }
    Text& operator<<(std::uint64_t v) {
        char digits[20];
        std::size_t n = 0;
        do {
            digits[n++] = static_cast<char>('0' + v % 10);
            v /= 10;
        } while (v);
        while (n) put(&digits[--n], 1);
        return *this;
    }
    Text& hex(std::uint32_t v) {
        char digits[10] = {'0', 'x'};
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) digits[2 + i] = "0123456789abcdef"[(v >> (28 - 4 * i)) & 0xF];
        return put(digits, 10);
    }
    // A string from the blob, quoted: a type id or a node id, which may hold anything the document did.
    Text& quoted(std::string_view s) { return *this << "\"" << s << "\""; }
};

// A node's rp_error text, bounded (a node may leave it unterminated), or the fallback when it gave none.
std::string_view reason(const rp_error& e, const char* fallback) {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    while (n < sizeof e.message && e.message[n]) ++n;
    return n ? std::string_view(e.message, n) : std::string_view(fallback);
}

// Starts an error: the code and the node at fault (empty for none), and the sentence to write.
Text fail(PlanLoadError* e, const char* code, std::string_view node = {}) {
    Text(e->code, sizeof e->code) << code;
    Text(e->node, sizeof e->node) << node;
    return Text(e->message, sizeof e->message);
}

// ---- the blob, read in place --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

template <class T>
T readAt(const std::uint8_t* data, std::uint64_t at) {
    T t;
    std::memcpy(&t, data + at, sizeof t);  // a blob in flash or a byte array need not be aligned for T
    return t;
}

// The blob once its header and section table have been checked: every record read from here is in bounds.
struct Blob {
    const std::uint8_t* data = nullptr;
    std::size_t         size = 0;
    Header              h{};

    std::uint32_t count(Section s) const { return h.sections[static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s)].count; }
    std::uint64_t offset(Section s) const { return h.sections[static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s)].offset; }
    template <class T>
    T record(Section s, std::uint32_t i) const { return readAt<T>(data, offset(s) + std::uint64_t{i} * sizeof(T)); }
    std::uint32_t word(Section s, std::uint32_t i) const { return record<std::uint32_t>(s, i); }
    const std::uint8_t* bytes(Section s, std::uint32_t at) const { return data + offset(s) + at; }
    std::string_view text(const Bytes& b) const {
        return {reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes(Section::Strings, b.offset)), b.size};
    }

    NodeRecord node(std::uint32_t i) const { return record<NodeRecord>(Section::Nodes, i); }
    StepRecord step(std::uint32_t i) const { return record<StepRecord>(Section::Steps, i); }
    std::string_view nodeId(std::uint32_t i) const { return text(node(i).id); }
    double sampleRate() const { return joinDouble(h.sampleRate); }
};

const rp_node_type* findType(std::span<const rp_package* const> types, std::string_view id) {
    for (const rp_package* p : types) {
        if (!p || p->abi_version != RP_ABI_VERSION) continue;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < p->node_type_count; ++i) {
            const rp_node_type* t = p->node_types[i];
            if (t && t->id && std::strlen(t->id) == id.size() && std::memcmp(t->id, id.data(), id.size()) == 0)
                return t;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

const char* sectionName(Section s) {
    switch (s) {
        case Section::Strings: return "strings";
        case Section::Settings: return "settings";
        case Section::Nodes: return "nodes";
        case Section::Steps: return "steps";
        case Section::Views: return "views";
        case Section::ParamViews: return "param views";
        case Section::Channels: return "channel entries";
        case Section::Queues: return "queues";
        case Section::Streams: return "streams";
        case Section::Clears: return "queues to clear";
        case Section::Rolls: return "streams to roll";
        case Section::Feedback: return "feedback copies";
        case Section::Masks: return "masks";
        case Section::MaskBytes: return "mask bytes";
        case Section::Peers: return "peer lists";
        case Section::PeerNodes: return "peer entries";
        case Section::ParamStarts: return "param starts";
        case Section::Count: break;
    }
    return "?";
}

// The checks that every index and offset a record holds is in bounds, each refusal naming the record and the bound.
struct Checker {
    const Blob&    b;
    PlanLoadError* err;

    // [first, first + count) within `limit` of `what`, for the `field` of record `index` of `section`.
    bool inRange(Section section, std::uint32_t at, const char* field, std::uint64_t first, std::uint64_t count,
                 std::uint64_t limit, const char* what) {
        if (first <= limit && count <= limit - first) return true;
        fail(err, "plan-malformed") << sectionName(section) << " record " << std::uint64_t{at} << "'s " << field
                                    << " [" << first << ", " << first + count << ") runs past the plan's " << limit
                                    << " " << what;
        return false;
    }
    bool isIndex(Section section, std::uint32_t at, const char* field, std::uint64_t value, std::uint64_t limit,
                 const char* what) {
        if (value < limit) return true;
        fail(err, "plan-malformed") << sectionName(section) << " record " << std::uint64_t{at} << " names " << field
                                    << " " << value << ", past the plan's " << limit << " " << what;
        return false;
    }
    bool badKind(Section section, std::uint32_t at, std::uint32_t kind) {
        fail(err, "plan-malformed") << sectionName(section) << " record " << std::uint64_t{at} << " has port kind "
                                    << std::uint64_t{kind} << ", which it cannot have";
        return false;
    }
    std::uint32_t n(Section s) const { return b.count(s); }

    // A run of the channel table, a queue, a stream or a cell, by port kind: what a view or a feedback copy holds.
    bool port(Section section, std::uint32_t at, std::uint32_t kind, std::uint32_t which, std::uint32_t count) {
        switch (kind) {
            case RP_PORT_AUDIO:
                return inRange(section, at, "channels", which, count, n(Section::Channels), "channel entries");
            case RP_PORT_EVENTS:
            case RP_PORT_BYTES: return isIndex(section, at, "queue", which, n(Section::Queues), "queues");
            case RP_PORT_CONTROL: return isIndex(section, at, "stream", which, n(Section::Streams), "streams");
            case RP_PORT_RESOURCE: return isIndex(section, at, "cell", which, b.h.cells, "resource cells");
            case RP_PORT_LINK: return true;
            default: return badKind(section, at, kind);
        }
    }

    bool all() {
        const std::uint32_t nodes = n(Section::Nodes), steps = n(Section::Steps);
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
            const NodeRecord r = b.node(i);
            if (!inRange(Section::Nodes, i, "id", r.id.offset, r.id.size, n(Section::Strings), "string bytes") ||
                !inRange(Section::Nodes, i, "type", r.type.offset, r.type.size, n(Section::Strings), "string bytes") ||
                !inRange(Section::Nodes, i, "settings", r.settings.offset, r.settings.size, n(Section::Settings),
                     "settings bytes") ||
                !isIndex(Section::Nodes, i, "group", r.group, nodes, "nodes") ||
                !isIndex(Section::Nodes, i, "step", r.step, steps, "steps"))
                return false;
        }
        // One step per node, each the step its node names, so every node runs exactly once.
        if (steps != nodes) {
            fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the plan has " << std::uint64_t{nodes} << " nodes and "
                                        << std::uint64_t{steps} << " steps, one per node";
            return false;
        }
        std::uint32_t groupStart = 0, groupEnd = 0;  // the coupled group a step is in: [groupStart, groupEnd)
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < steps; ++i) {
            const StepRecord s = b.step(i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::Steps, i, "node", s.node, nodes, "nodes") ||
                !inRange(Section::Steps, i, "inputs", s.firstInput, s.inputCount, n(Section::Views), "views") ||
                !inRange(Section::Steps, i, "outputs", s.firstOutput, s.outputCount, n(Section::Views), "views") ||
                !inRange(Section::Steps, i, "params", s.firstParam, s.paramCount, n(Section::ParamViews),
                         "param views"))
                return false;
            if (b.node(s.node).step != i) {
                fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "step " << std::uint64_t{i} << " runs node " << std::uint64_t{s.node}
                                            << ", whose step is " << std::uint64_t{b.node(s.node).step};
                return false;
            }
            // A group's members follow its first, which alone carries its size, and share its group.
            const bool inGroup = i < groupEnd;
            if (s.groupSize == 1 || (s.groupSize > 1 && (inGroup || s.groupSize > steps - i)) ||
                (inGroup && b.node(s.node).group != b.node(b.step(groupStart).node).group)) {
                fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "step " << std::uint64_t{i} << "'s coupled group of "
                                            << std::uint64_t{s.groupSize} << " does not fit the schedule";
                return false;
            }
            if (s.groupSize > 1) {
                groupStart = i;
                groupEnd = i + s.groupSize;
            }
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Views); ++i) {
            const auto v = b.record<ViewRecord>(Section::Views, i);
            if (!port(Section::Views, i, v.kind, v.index, v.count)) return false;
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::ParamViews); ++i) {
            const auto v = b.record<ParamViewRecord>(Section::ParamViews, i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::ParamViews, i, "stream", v.stream, n(Section::Streams), "streams")) return false;
            if (v.wired > 1) {
                fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "param views record " << std::uint64_t{i} << " has a wired flag of "
                                            << std::uint64_t{v.wired} << ", not 0 or 1";
                return false;
            }
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Channels); ++i)
            if (!isIndex(Section::Channels, i, "buffer", b.word(Section::Channels, i), b.h.buffers, "audio buffers"))
                return false;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Clears); ++i) {
            const auto c = b.record<ClearRecord>(Section::Clears, i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::Clears, i, "queue", c.queue, n(Section::Queues), "queues") ||
                (c.node != kNoNode && !isIndex(Section::Clears, i, "node", c.node, nodes, "nodes")))
                return false;
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Rolls); ++i)
            if (!isIndex(Section::Rolls, i, "stream", b.word(Section::Rolls, i), n(Section::Streams), "streams"))
                return false;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Feedback); ++i) {
            const auto f = b.record<FeedbackRecord>(Section::Feedback, i);
            if (f.kind == RP_PORT_LINK || f.kind == RP_PORT_RESOURCE) return badKind(Section::Feedback, i, f.kind);
            if (!port(Section::Feedback, i, f.kind, f.back, f.channels) ||
                !port(Section::Feedback, i, f.kind, f.front, f.channels))
                return false;
            if (f.kind == RP_PORT_AUDIO && f.frames > b.h.maxFrames) {
                fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "feedback copy " << std::uint64_t{i} << " holds "
                                            << std::uint64_t{f.frames} << " frames, past the plan's maxFrames of "
                                            << std::uint64_t{b.h.maxFrames};
                return false;
            }
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Masks); ++i) {
            const auto m = b.record<MaskRecord>(Section::Masks, i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::Masks, i, "node", m.node, nodes, "nodes") ||
                !inRange(Section::Masks, i, "flags", m.offset, m.count, n(Section::MaskBytes), "mask bytes"))
                return false;
            if (m.count != b.step(b.node(m.node).step).outputCount) {
                fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the mask for " << std::uint64_t{m.node} << " has "
                                            << std::uint64_t{m.count} << " flags, for a node of "
                                            << std::uint64_t{b.step(b.node(m.node).step).outputCount} << " outputs";
                return false;
            }
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::Peers); ++i) {
            const auto p = b.record<PeerRecord>(Section::Peers, i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::Peers, i, "node", p.node, nodes, "nodes") ||
                !inRange(Section::Peers, i, "peers", p.first, p.count, n(Section::PeerNodes), "peer entries"))
                return false;
        }
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::PeerNodes); ++i)
            if (!isIndex(Section::PeerNodes, i, "node", b.word(Section::PeerNodes, i), nodes, "nodes")) return false;
        for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < n(Section::ParamStarts); ++i) {
            const auto s = b.record<ParamStartRecord>(Section::ParamStarts, i);
            if (!isIndex(Section::ParamStarts, i, "stream", s.stream, n(Section::Streams), "streams")) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

// The blob's header, its length, its CRC, its section table, then every record and every type id.
bool check(std::span<const std::uint8_t> data, std::span<const rp_package* const> types, Blob& b,
           PlanLoadError* err) {
    b.data = data.data();
    b.size = data.size();
    if (b.size < 8 || std::memcmp(b.data, kMagic, sizeof kMagic) != 0) {
        fail(err, "plan-format") << "not a plan blob: it does not start with \"RPPL\"";
        return false;
    }
    const auto version = readAt<std::uint32_t>(b.data, 4);
    if (version != kVersion) {
        fail(err, "plan-version") << "plan format " << std::uint64_t{version} << ", this loader reads "
                                  << std::uint64_t{kVersion};
        return false;
    }
    if (b.size < sizeof(Header) + sizeof(std::uint32_t)) {
        fail(err, "plan-truncated") << "the blob is " << std::uint64_t{b.size} << " bytes, shorter than its header";
        return false;
    }
    b.h = readAt<Header>(b.data, 0);
    if (b.h.size != b.size) {
        fail(err, "plan-truncated") << "the blob is " << std::uint64_t{b.size} << " bytes, its header says "
                                    << std::uint64_t{b.h.size};
        return false;
    }
    const std::uint64_t body = b.size - sizeof(std::uint32_t);
    const auto stored = readAt<std::uint32_t>(b.data, body);
    const std::uint32_t computed = crc32(b.data, static_cast<std::size_t>(body));
    if (stored != computed) {
        Text t = fail(err, "plan-crc");
        t << "the blob's CRC is ";
        t.hex(stored) << ", its bytes give ";
        t.hex(computed);
        return false;
    }
    if (b.h.target != kTargetRp2350) {
        fail(err, "plan-target") << "the plan is for target " << std::uint64_t{b.h.target} << ", this loader runs "
                                 << kTargetName << " plans";
        return false;
    }
    const double rate = b.sampleRate();
    if (b.h.maxFrames == 0 || !std::isfinite(rate) || rate <= 0.0) {
        fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the plan's sample rate and maxFrames must be positive";
        return false;
    }
    if (b.h.sectionCount != kSectionCount) {
        fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the plan has " << std::uint64_t{b.h.sectionCount} << " sections, not "
                                    << std::uint64_t{kSectionCount};
        return false;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < kSectionCount; ++i) {
        const SectionEntry& s = b.h.sections[i];
        const auto section = static_cast<Section>(i);
        if (s.recordBytes != recordBytes(section)) {
            fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the " << sectionName(section) << " section's records are "
                                        << std::uint64_t{s.recordBytes} << " bytes, not "
                                        << std::uint64_t{recordBytes(section)};
            return false;
        }
        const std::uint64_t bytes = std::uint64_t{s.count} * s.recordBytes;
        if (s.offset % 4 != 0 || s.offset < sizeof(Header) || s.offset > body || bytes > body - s.offset) {
            fail(err, "plan-malformed") << "the " << sectionName(section) << " section [" << std::uint64_t{s.offset}
                                        << ", " << s.offset + bytes << ") is not within the blob's "
                                        << body << " bytes";
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (!Checker{b, err}.all()) return false;
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Nodes); ++i) {
        const std::string_view type = b.text(b.node(i).type);
        if (!findType(types, type)) {
            Text t = fail(err, "unknown-type", b.nodeId(i));
            t << "no node type ";
            t.quoted(type) << " is registered";
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// ---- the layout ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// What the arena's start is aligned to: the target's alignment, and the compiler's max_align_t where that is more (the
// desktop's), so every request the layout makes (an instance's at most kTargetAlign, a pool's at most its type's) is
// met by an offset of the same alignment and the layout is the same computation wherever it runs.
constexpr std::uint64_t kBaseAlign =
    kTargetAlign > alignof(std::max_align_t) ? kTargetAlign : alignof(std::max_align_t);
constexpr std::uint64_t kUnlimited = ~std::uint64_t{0};

// Bump allocation from offset 0, over at most `limit` bytes of `base`. With no base it only counts (the exporter's
// sizing pass); with one, it hands out zeroed memory while the request ends within the limit, and past it keeps
// counting and hands out nothing, so one pass both lays a plan out and finds how far past the arena it would run.
struct Bump {
    std::byte*    base = nullptr;  // null: counting only
    std::uint64_t limit = kUnlimited;
    std::uint64_t used = 0;
    bool          overflow = false;

    // The offset of `bytes` aligned to `align`, or past the end (nothing to hand out) when the sums would wrap.
    std::uint64_t take(std::uint64_t bytes, std::uint64_t align) {
        const std::uint64_t at = (used + (align - 1)) & ~(align - 1);
        // Past 2^48 bytes no arena is that large, and the sums below cannot wrap.
        if (at < used || bytes > (std::uint64_t{1} << 48) || at + bytes > (std::uint64_t{1} << 48)) {
            overflow = true;
            return used;
        }
        used = at + bytes;
        return at;
    }
    std::byte* give(std::uint64_t at) {
        if (!base || overflow || used > limit) return nullptr;
        std::memset(base + at, 0, static_cast<std::size_t>(used - at));
        return base + at;
    }
    // a * b, or a size no arena holds where that would wrap.
    static std::uint64_t product(std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t b) {
        return a && b > (std::uint64_t{1} << 62) / a ? std::uint64_t{1} << 62 : a * b;
    }
    template <class T>
    T* array(std::uint64_t count) {
        return reinterpret_cast<T*>(give(take(product(count, sizeof(T)), alignof(T))));
    }
    std::byte* raw(std::uint64_t bytes, std::uint64_t align) { return give(take(bytes, align)); }
};

// Where layout() put everything (placing), or nulls (measuring).
struct Placed {
    LoadedPlan*        plan = nullptr;
    LoadedNode*        nodes = nullptr;
    PlanStep*          steps = nullptr;
    rp_port_view*      views = nullptr;
    rp_control_queue** paramViews = nullptr;
    std::uint8_t*      wired = nullptr;  // per param view
    float**            channels = nullptr;
    std::byte*         buffers = nullptr;
    std::uint64_t      bufferStride = 0;
    rp_queue*          queues = nullptr;
    rp_control_queue*  streams = nullptr;
    rp_resource**      cells = nullptr;
    OutputQueue*       clears = nullptr;
    rp_control_queue** rolls = nullptr;
    FeedbackCopy*      feedback = nullptr;
    rp_node**          peers = nullptr;
};

rp_settings settingsOf(const Blob& b, const NodeRecord& r) {
    return {reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b.bytes(Section::Settings, r.settings.offset)), r.settings.size,
            RP_SETTINGS_MSGPACK};
}

// The plan's whole layout in the arena: its own structures and pools first, then each node's instance in the
// document's order, placed while they fit the bump's base (when it has one). It fills `size` and, past `limit` bytes,
// refuses naming the first node whose instance does not fit, or the plan's own structures when they alone do not.
bool layout(const Blob& b, std::span<const rp_package* const> types, Bump& bump, Placed& p, std::uint64_t limit,
            PlanSize* size, PlanLoadError* err) {
    const std::uint32_t nodes = b.count(Section::Nodes);
    p.plan = bump.array<LoadedPlan>(1);
    p.nodes = bump.array<LoadedNode>(nodes);
    p.steps = bump.array<PlanStep>(b.count(Section::Steps));
    p.views = bump.array<rp_port_view>(b.count(Section::Views));
    p.paramViews = bump.array<rp_control_queue*>(b.count(Section::ParamViews));
    p.wired = bump.array<std::uint8_t>(b.count(Section::ParamViews));
    p.channels = bump.array<float*>(b.count(Section::Channels));
    p.bufferStride = (std::uint64_t{b.h.maxFrames} * sizeof(float) + (kBaseAlign - 1)) & ~(kBaseAlign - 1);
    p.buffers = bump.raw(Bump::product(p.bufferStride, b.h.buffers), kBaseAlign);
    p.queues = bump.array<rp_queue>(b.count(Section::Queues));
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Queues); ++i) {
        const auto q = b.record<QueueRecord>(Section::Queues, i);
        auto* items = bump.array<rp_message>(q.messages);
        auto* bytes = bump.array<std::uint8_t>(q.bytes);
        if (p.queues) p.queues[i] = rp_queue{items, 0, q.messages, bytes, 0, q.bytes, 0};
    }
    p.streams = bump.array<rp_control_queue>(b.count(Section::Streams));
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Streams); ++i) {
        const auto s = b.record<StreamRecord>(Section::Streams, i);
        auto* changes = bump.array<rp_control_change>(s.changes);
        if (p.streams) p.streams[i] = rp_control_queue{joinDouble(s.start), changes, 0, s.changes, 0};
    }
    p.cells = bump.array<rp_resource*>(b.h.cells);
    p.clears = bump.array<OutputQueue>(b.count(Section::Clears));
    p.rolls = bump.array<rp_control_queue*>(b.count(Section::Rolls));
    p.feedback = bump.array<FeedbackCopy>(b.count(Section::Feedback));
    p.peers = bump.array<rp_node*>(b.count(Section::PeerNodes));
    const std::uint64_t planBytes = bump.used;

    std::uint64_t instanceBytes = 0;
    std::uint32_t tip = kNoNode;  // the first node whose instance ends past the arena
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
        const NodeRecord r = b.node(i);
        const rp_node_type* type = findType(types, b.text(r.type));  // check() found every one
        const rp_settings settings = settingsOf(b, r);
        rp_memory_req req{};
        rp_error nodeErr{};
        if (!type->query_memory(type, &settings, &req, &nodeErr)) {
            fail(err, "settings-invalid", b.nodeId(i)) << reason(nodeErr, "the node refused its settings");
            return false;
        }
        const std::uint64_t align = req.align ? req.align : kTargetAlign;  // 0 asks for nothing in particular
        if ((align & (align - 1)) != 0 || align > kTargetAlign) {
            fail(err, "node-memory", b.nodeId(i))
                << "node asked for an alignment of " << align << ", where an " << kTargetName
                << " arena gives a power of two up to " << std::uint64_t{kTargetAlign};
            return false;
        }
        std::byte* memory = bump.raw(req.size ? req.size : 1, align);
        instanceBytes += req.size;
        if (tip == kNoNode && bump.used > limit) tip = i;
        if (p.nodes) {
            LoadedNode& n = *new (&p.nodes[i]) LoadedNode{};
            const std::string_view id = b.nodeId(i);
            n.id = id.data();
            n.idSize = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(id.size());
            n.type = type;
            n.memory = memory;
            n.memoryBytes = req.size;
            n.step = r.step;
        }
    }
    if (bump.overflow) {
        fail(err, "arena") << "the plan's sizes overflow what any arena holds";
        return false;
    }
    if (size) {
        // Saturated, where a 32-bit size_t cannot hold the total (a plan no device arena holds either).
        constexpr std::uint64_t kMaxSize = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
        size->bytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(bump.used < kMaxSize ? bump.used : kMaxSize);
        size->instanceBytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(instanceBytes < kMaxSize ? instanceBytes : kMaxSize);
        size->nodes = nodes;
    }
    if (bump.used > limit) {
        const std::uint64_t over = bump.used - limit;
        if (planBytes > limit) {
            fail(err, "arena") << "the plan's buffers, queues and steps take " << planBytes << " bytes, past the "
                               << limit << "-byte arena by " << planBytes - limit
                               << " before any node; the whole plan needs " << bump.used;
        } else {
            const NodeRecord r = b.node(tip);
            fail(err, "arena", b.nodeId(tip))
                .quoted(b.nodeId(tip)) << " (" << b.text(r.type) << ") does not fit: the plan needs " << bump.used
                << " bytes, " << over << " past the " << limit << "-byte arena";
        }
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Every pool's contents and every pointer between them, from the records: nothing here calls a node.
void bind(const Blob& b, const Placed& p) {
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Channels); ++i)
        p.channels[i] = reinterpret_cast<float*>(p.buffers + p.bufferStride * b.word(Section::Channels, i));
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Views); ++i) {
        const auto r = b.record<ViewRecord>(Section::Views, i);
        rp_port_view& v = p.views[i];
        v.kind = r.kind;
        switch (r.kind) {
            case RP_PORT_AUDIO: v.u.audio = rp_audio_view{p.channels + r.index, r.count}; break;
            case RP_PORT_EVENTS:
            case RP_PORT_BYTES: v.u.queue = &p.queues[r.index]; break;
            case RP_PORT_CONTROL: v.u.control = &p.streams[r.index]; break;
            case RP_PORT_RESOURCE: v.u.resource = &p.cells[r.index]; break;
            default: break;
        }
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::ParamViews); ++i) {
        const auto v = b.record<ParamViewRecord>(Section::ParamViews, i);
        p.paramViews[i] = &p.streams[v.stream];
        p.wired[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v.wired);
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Steps); ++i) {
        const StepRecord s = b.step(i);
        PlanStep& step = *new (&p.steps[i]) PlanStep{};
        step.process.inputs = p.views + s.firstInput;
        step.process.input_count = s.inputCount;
        step.process.outputs = p.views + s.firstOutput;
        step.process.output_count = s.outputCount;
        step.process.params = p.paramViews + s.firstParam;
        step.process.param_count = s.paramCount;
        step.groupSize = s.groupSize;
        step.faulted = &p.nodes[s.node].faulted;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Clears); ++i) {
        const auto c = b.record<ClearRecord>(Section::Clears, i);
        p.clears[i] = OutputQueue{&p.queues[c.queue], c.node == kNoNode ? nullptr : &p.nodes[c.node].drops};
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Rolls); ++i) p.rolls[i] = &p.streams[b.word(Section::Rolls, i)];
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Feedback); ++i) {
        const auto r = b.record<FeedbackRecord>(Section::Feedback, i);
        FeedbackCopy& f = p.feedback[i];
        f = FeedbackCopy{};
        f.kind = static_cast<rp_port_kind>(r.kind);
        if (r.kind == RP_PORT_AUDIO) {
            f.backChannels = p.channels + r.back;
            f.frontChannels = p.channels + r.front;
            f.channels = r.channels;
            f.capacity = r.frames;
        } else if (r.kind == RP_PORT_CONTROL) {
            f.backControl = &p.streams[r.back];
            f.frontControl = &p.streams[r.front];
        } else {
            f.backQueue = &p.queues[r.back];
            f.frontQueue = &p.queues[r.front];
        }
    }
}

// Deactivates and destroys nodes [0, made), the last first.
void unwind(LoadedNode* nodes, std::uint32_t made) {
    while (made-- > 0) {
        LoadedNode& n = nodes[made];
        if (!n.node) continue;
        if (n.active) n.node->vt->deactivate(n.node);
        n.type->destroy(n.node);
        n.node = nullptr;
        n.active = false;
    }
}

// Create and activate every node, bind the steps to them, then what PlanStorage::adopt applies: peers, connected
// outputs, param starts.
bool runUp(const Blob& b, const Placed& p, const rp_host* host, PlanLoadError* err) {
    const std::uint32_t nodes = b.count(Section::Nodes);
    const double rate = b.sampleRate();
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
        LoadedNode& n = p.nodes[i];
        const rp_settings settings = settingsOf(b, b.node(i));
        rp_error nodeErr{};
        n.node = n.type->create(n.type, host, n.memory, &settings, &nodeErr);
        if (!n.node) {
            fail(err, "create-failed", n.name()) << reason(nodeErr, "the node could not be created");
            unwind(p.nodes, i);
            return false;
        }
        if (!n.node->vt->activate(n.node, rate, b.h.maxFrames, &nodeErr)) {
            fail(err, "activate-failed", n.name()) << reason(nodeErr, "the node could not be activated");
            unwind(p.nodes, i + 1);
            return false;
        }
        n.active = true;
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0, groupEnd = 0; i < b.count(Section::Steps); ++i) {
        PlanStep& step = p.steps[i];
        LoadedNode& n = p.nodes[b.step(i).node];
        step.node = n.node;
        if (step.groupSize > 1) groupEnd = i + step.groupSize;
        if (i < groupEnd) {
            step.step = static_cast<const rp_step_interface*>(n.node->vt->get_interface(n.node, RP_STEP_INTERFACE));
            if (!step.step) {
                fail(err, "link-without-step", n.name())
                    .quoted(n.name()) << " is coupled but does not implement " RP_STEP_INTERFACE;
                unwind(p.nodes, nodes);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    const std::uint32_t peerLists = b.count(Section::Peers);
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < peerLists; ++i) {
        const LoadedNode& n = p.nodes[b.record<PeerRecord>(Section::Peers, i).node];
        if (!n.node->vt->get_interface(n.node, RP_LINK_INTERFACE)) {
            fail(err, "peers-without-link", n.name()).quoted(n.name()) << " has peers but does not implement "
                                                                          RP_LINK_INTERFACE;
            unwind(p.nodes, nodes);
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < peerLists; ++i) {
        const auto r = b.record<PeerRecord>(Section::Peers, i);
        rp_node* const node = p.nodes[r.node].node;
        for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < r.count; ++k)
            p.peers[r.first + k] = p.nodes[b.word(Section::PeerNodes, r.first + k)].node;
        const auto* link = static_cast<const rp_link_interface*>(node->vt->get_interface(node, RP_LINK_INTERFACE));
        link->set_peers(node, p.peers + r.first, r.count);
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::Masks); ++i) {
        const auto m = b.record<MaskRecord>(Section::Masks, i);
        rp_node* const node = p.nodes[m.node].node;
        node->vt->ports_changed(node, b.bytes(Section::MaskBytes, m.offset), m.count);
    }
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < b.count(Section::ParamStarts); ++i) {
        const auto s = b.record<ParamStartRecord>(Section::ParamStarts, i);
        p.streams[s.stream].start = joinDouble(s.value);
        p.streams[s.stream].count = 0;
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

LoadedNode* LoadedPlan::find(std::string_view id) const {
    for (LoadedNode& n : nodes)
        if (n.name() == id) return &n;
    return nullptr;
}

rp_control_queue* LoadedPlan::param(std::uint32_t n, std::uint32_t k) const {
    if (n >= nodes.size()) return nullptr;
    const rp_process& p = view.steps[nodes[n].step].process;
    if (k >= p.param_count) return nullptr;
    const auto at = static_cast<std::size_t>(p.params + k - paramViews);
    return wired[at] ? nullptr : p.params[k];
}

bool sizePlan(std::span<const std::uint8_t> blob, std::span<const rp_package* const> types, std::size_t arenaBytes,
              PlanSize* size, PlanLoadError* error) {
    PlanLoadError ignored;
    if (!error) error = &ignored;
    Blob b;
    if (!check(blob, types, b, error)) return false;
    Bump measure;
    Placed none;
    return layout(b, types, measure, none, arenaBytes ? arenaBytes : kUnlimited, size, error);
}

LoadedPlan* loadPlan(std::span<const std::uint8_t> blob, std::span<std::byte> arena,
                     std::span<const rp_package* const> types, const rp_host* host, PlanLoadError* error) {
    PlanLoadError ignored;
    if (!error) error = &ignored;
    if (reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(arena.data()) % kBaseAlign != 0) {
        fail(error, "arena") << "the arena must be aligned to " << kBaseAlign << " bytes";
        return nullptr;
    }
    Blob b;
    if (!check(blob, types, b, error)) return nullptr;
    // One pass lays the plan out and sizes it: each node's query_memory is asked once, so what is placed is what was
    // measured. A plan past the arena is refused here, having written only into the arena, and created nothing.
    Bump place{arena.data(), arena.size()};
    Placed p;
    PlanSize size;
    if (!layout(b, types, place, p, arena.size(), &size, error)) return nullptr;
    LoadedPlan& plan = *new (p.plan) LoadedPlan{};
    plan.sampleRate = b.sampleRate();
    plan.maxFrames = b.h.maxFrames;
    plan.nodes = std::span<LoadedNode>(p.nodes, b.count(Section::Nodes));
    plan.bytes = size.bytes;
    plan.paramViews = p.paramViews;
    plan.wired = p.wired;
    bind(b, p);
    plan.view = PlanView{std::span<PlanStep>(p.steps, b.count(Section::Steps)),
                         std::span<const OutputQueue>(p.clears, b.count(Section::Clears)),
                         std::span<rp_control_queue* const>(p.rolls, b.count(Section::Rolls)),
                         std::span<const FeedbackCopy>(p.feedback, b.count(Section::Feedback)), &plan.faults,
                         &plan.drops};
    if (!runUp(b, p, host, error)) return nullptr;
    return &plan;
}

void unloadPlan(LoadedPlan* plan) {
    if (!plan) return;
    unwind(plan->nodes.data(), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(plan->nodes.size()));
}

}  // namespace rp::graph
````

- [ ] **Step 3: The device-mode objects as a CMake function**

`retroplug_device_mode_objects(<target> PACKAGES ... [SOURCES] [INCLUDES] [OWNERS var])` in `cmake/packages.cmake` is
the device-mode object library `tests.cmake` built by hand: the sources of every listed package's `device` entries and
the static libraries they link, compiled with the device flags and the token rename (`rp=rp_devmode`,
`<entry>_device_mode`), with `/bigobj` on MSVC set explicitly (the old library got it only from `packages/native`'s
directory), plus a generated `rp_register_device_mode_packages()` listing the renamed entries in the product's order.
`Packages.hpp` declares it, with `deviceModePackages()` as a span.

````diff
diff --git a/cmake/packages.cmake b/cmake/packages.cmake
index 635f877fe..8f01fea89 100644
--- a/cmake/packages.cmake
+++ b/cmake/packages.cmake
@@ -444,6 +444,148 @@ ${_body}}
     set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY RP_PRODUCT_${product}_ENTRIES ${_entries})
 endfunction()
 
+# retroplug_device_mode_objects(<target> PACKAGES <package>... [SOURCES <source>...] [INCLUDES <dir>...]
+#                               [OWNERS <variable>]): the device's build of the packages' `device` entries, for a
+# desktop binary that holds it beside the desktop's build of the same entries: the device-mode test, and the plan
+# exporter (packages/graph-runtime/export-plan), which plans with the desktop's build of each type and sizes the plan
+# with the device's. An object library, EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, of the sources of every `device` entry's target of the
+# packages (each one's <target>-device check holds the same list), plus SOURCES, compiled as a device compiles them (the
+# device flags, no exceptions, no RTTI) and one definition more, rp=rp_devmode: a token rename, so every `namespace rp`
+# and `rp::` in their translation units is rp_devmode's, and no C++ name has a definition in each build (rp::text has
+# no str() in the device's, its instance owns its settings in place, and the linker would otherwise keep whichever
+# definition it saw first). rp_node, rp_package, RP_DEVICE, a header's name and a string literal ("rp.core.gain") are
+# other tokens and keep their spelling. The kernels the nodes call (rp::dsp) are compiled into the objects too, as
+# rp_devmode::dsp, which also proves them built without exceptions: the sources of every package library a device
+# entry's target links. What the rename leaves the same in both builds is a name outside rp, so a source built both
+# ways keeps its names with linkage under rp (rp::graph, rp::dsp, ...) or in an anonymous namespace. It is a rename of
+# these objects, rather than a namespace the SDK opens in device mode, because only such a binary holds both builds: a
+# device image and the <target>-device checks hold one, and compile the sources exactly as written. (An inline
+# namespace rp::device would move a source's names with no change to it, but MSVC does not extend one through a later
+# `namespace rp::graph` (CWG 2061).) The packages' C entries, which no namespace reaches, are renamed by a compile
+# definition each, <entry>_device_mode, and the objects define rp_register_device_mode_packages() (graph/Packages.hpp),
+# which lists the renamed entries in the order PACKAGES does, as a device product's rp_register_packages() lists its
+# own. The binary keeps exceptions in its own translation units (Catch2 is built with them) and reaches the device-mode
+# code through the C ABI alone, as a device's host would. MSVC keeps its /EHsc: a second /EH option on one command line
+# is the D9025 warning AGENTS.md describes, and the GCC and Clang builds are where -fno-exceptions is proved. OWNERS
+# names a variable set to the desktop targets the objects twin, which the binary links for the desktop's build.
+function(retroplug_device_mode_objects target)
+    cmake_parse_arguments(P "" "OWNERS" "PACKAGES;SOURCES;INCLUDES" ${ARGN})
+    if(RP_DEVICE_BUILD)
+        message(FATAL_ERROR "retroplug_device_mode_objects(${target}): a device build compiles every package in device "
+                            "mode already")
+    endif()
+    if(P_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS OR NOT P_PACKAGES)
+        message(FATAL_ERROR "retroplug_device_mode_objects(${target}): PACKAGES is required, and nothing else is "
+                            "unnamed (${P_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS})")
+    endif()
+    # Every device entry's owner, of every package: a library one of them links that is another's owner is compiled
+    # from that owner's own sources, once, and only where its package is listed.
+    get_property(_known GLOBAL PROPERTY RP_PACKAGES)
+    set(_allOwners "")
+    foreach(_p IN LISTS _known)
+        get_property(_t GLOBAL PROPERTY RP_PACKAGE_${_p}_DEVICE_TARGETS)
+        list(APPEND _allOwners ${_t})
+    endforeach()
+    set(_sources "")
+    set(_includes "")
+    set(_definitions "")
+    set(_owners "")
+    set(_libraries "")
+    set(_entries "")
+    foreach(_p IN LISTS P_PACKAGES)
+        if(NOT _p IN_LIST _known)
+            message(FATAL_ERROR "retroplug_device_mode_objects(${target}): no package `${_p}`")
+        endif()
+        get_property(_e GLOBAL PROPERTY RP_PACKAGE_${_p}_DEVICE_ENTRIES)
+        get_property(_t GLOBAL PROPERTY RP_PACKAGE_${_p}_DEVICE_TARGETS)
+        if(NOT _e)
+            message(FATAL_ERROR "retroplug_device_mode_objects(${target}): package `${_p}` has no `device` entry")
+        endif()
+        list(APPEND _entries ${_e})
+        foreach(_owner IN LISTS _t)
+            # The owner's <target>-device check holds its sources made absolute (_retroplug_device_check).
+            get_target_property(_s ${_owner}-device SOURCES)
+            list(APPEND _sources ${_s})
+            list(APPEND _owners ${_owner})
+            list(APPEND _includes $<TARGET_PROPERTY:${_owner},INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
+            list(APPEND _definitions $<TARGET_PROPERTY:${_owner},COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>)
+            # Every static library it links (the rp::dsp kernels), and theirs: renamed with it, so compiled with it, so
+            # a library here is the owner's own and not a vendored one. The SDK is headers alone in device mode, so
+            # retroplug-node-sdk's own sources (the description library) are not the device's.
+            get_target_property(_pending ${_owner} LINK_LIBRARIES)
+            while(_pending)
+                list(POP_FRONT _pending _lib)
+                if(NOT TARGET ${_lib} OR _lib STREQUAL "retroplug-node-sdk" OR _lib IN_LIST _libraries
+                   OR _lib IN_LIST _allOwners)
+                    continue()
+                endif()
+                get_target_property(_type ${_lib} TYPE)
+                if(NOT _type STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
+                    continue()
+                endif()
+                list(APPEND _libraries ${_lib})
+                get_target_property(_s ${_lib} SOURCES)
+                get_target_property(_dir ${_lib} SOURCE_DIR)
+                foreach(_one IN LISTS _s)
+                    cmake_path(ABSOLUTE_PATH _one BASE_DIRECTORY "${_dir}" OUTPUT_VARIABLE _one)
+                    list(APPEND _sources ${_one})
+                endforeach()
+                list(APPEND _includes $<TARGET_PROPERTY:${_lib},INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
+                list(APPEND _definitions $<TARGET_PROPERTY:${_lib},COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>)
+                get_target_property(_more ${_lib} LINK_LIBRARIES)
+                if(_more)
+                    list(APPEND _pending ${_more})
+                endif()
+            endwhile()
+        endforeach()
+    endforeach()
+    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _sources)
+    set(_renames "")
+    set(_decls "")
+    set(_body "")
+    list(LENGTH _entries _n)
+    set(_i 0)
+    foreach(_e IN LISTS _entries)
+        list(APPEND _renames ${_e}=${_e}_device_mode)
+        string(APPEND _decls "extern \"C\" const rp_package* ${_e}_device_mode(void);\n")
+        string(APPEND _body "    packages[${_i}] = ${_e}_device_mode();\n")
+        math(EXPR _i "${_i} + 1")
+    endforeach()
+    list(JOIN P_PACKAGES " " _listed)
+    set(_registration "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/device-mode/${target}-packages.cpp")
+    file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_registration}" CONTENT
+"// Generated by retroplug_device_mode_objects(${target}) in cmake/packages.cmake from the manifests of the packages it
+// lists: ${_listed}. Do not edit.
+
+#include <stddef.h>
+
+#include \"graph/rp_node.h\"
+
+${_decls}
+// Filled on every call, as a device product's registration is (a guarded static would need __cxa_guard_acquire).
+extern \"C\" const rp_package* const* rp_register_device_mode_packages(size_t* count) {
+    static const rp_package* packages[${_n}];
+${_body}    *count = ${_n};
+    return packages;
+}
+")
+    add_library(${target} OBJECT EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${_sources} ${P_SOURCES} "${_registration}")
+    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
+    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE ${_definitions} RP_DEVICE rp=rp_devmode ${_renames})
+    if(MSVC)
+        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/bigobj>)  # retroplug_package_library's
+    else()
+        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions;-fno-rtti>")
+    endif()
+    # The SDK's headers and reflect-cpp's (the field reflection, header-only and SYSTEM: nothing of reflect-cpp is
+    # linked), and the packages' own source roots for their headers and the kernels'.
+    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE retroplug-node-sdk-headers retroplug-reflect-headers)
+    target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ${_includes} ${P_INCLUDES})
+    if(P_OWNERS)
+        set(${P_OWNERS} ${_owners} PARENT_SCOPE)
+    endif()
+endfunction()
+
 # retroplug_providers_header(<file> <label> <package>...): generates <file>, the providers of the packages listed
 # (graph/rp_provider.h) as rp_start_providers(host), rp_restore_providers(providers), rp_stop_providers(providers) and
 # rp_register_package_rpc<Server>(server, providers), in the order the packages and their manifests list them
diff --git a/packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/Packages.hpp b/packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/Packages.hpp
index 52a87f8b5..949e4dc5f 100644
--- a/packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/Packages.hpp
+++ b/packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/Packages.hpp
@@ -15,6 +15,11 @@
 // (retroplug_check_products).
 extern "C" const rp_package* const* rp_register_packages(size_t* count);
 
+// The device's build of a product's packages, beside the desktop's in one desktop binary: the device-mode objects
+// (retroplug_device_mode_objects, cmake/packages.cmake) define it, listing their renamed entries in the order the
+// product lists the packages. Only a binary that links such objects has it (the plan exporter, the device-mode test).
+extern "C" const rp_package* const* rp_register_device_mode_packages(size_t* count);
+
 namespace rp::graph {
 
 // rp_register_packages(), as a span.
@@ -24,4 +29,11 @@ inline std::span<const rp_package* const> productPackages() {
     return {packages, n};
 }
 
+// rp_register_device_mode_packages(), as a span.
+inline std::span<const rp_package* const> deviceModePackages() {
+    std::size_t n = 0;
+    const rp_package* const* packages = rp_register_device_mode_packages(&n);
+    return {packages, n};
+}
+
 }  // namespace rp::graph
````

- [ ] **Step 4: The exporter and its tool**

`PlanExport.{hpp,cpp}` (in `retroplug-graph`): `exportPlan(document or json, registry, deviceTypes,
ExportOptions{target, sampleRate, maxFrames, arenaBytes, trialLoad})` answering `{errors, blob, size}`. It plans for
`Target::Pico` on a host of its own (`rp.host.devices/2` answering null, resources refused: a bound resource or one
named in settings is refused, "resources are not exported to rp2350 yet"), refuses a type with no
`rp.sdk.settings-json/1` (`settings-export`) and a non-finite sample rate (`export-options`), writes the blob, runs
the loader's sizing over it with the device's builds, and trial-loads it into a host buffer of exactly the measured
size (`trialLoad`, on by default, off only for a test that needs a blob the device refuses). `retroplug-export-plan
<plan.json> <out> [--arena <bytes>] [--sample-rate <hz>] [--max-frames <frames>] [--header <symbol>]`
(`EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL`, binary at `build/export-plan/retroplug-export-plan`) is a device product of `core dsp n8` with
their device-mode builds beside it; it writes the raw blob or, with `--header`, an `alignas(4) inline constexpr
std::uint8_t <symbol>[]` header, rewritten only on a change, and prints errors as `<code> <node>[.<port>]: <message>`
(exit 1; 2 for a usage error). The root `CMakeLists.txt` adds its directory after the packages; `warnings.cmake` puts
it, its device objects and `retroplug-graph-exec-device` on the Windows `/W4 /WX` list.

Create `packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/PlanExport.hpp`:

````cpp
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "graph/GraphDocument.hpp"
#include "graph/NodeRegistry.hpp"
#include "graph/PlanLoader.hpp"
#include "graph/Planner.hpp"
#include "graph/rp_node.h"

namespace rp::graph {

// The exporter (docs/modular-graph-phase-e3-design.md section 4): a graph document planned for a device and written as
// a plan blob (PlanBlob.hpp), which the device's loader (PlanLoader.hpp) lays out in its arena. Desktop only.
struct ExportOptions {
    Target        target = Target::Pico;  // the one target a plan is exported for
    double        sampleRate = 48000.0;
    std::uint32_t maxFrames = 256;
    std::size_t   arenaBytes = 0;  // the device's arena; 0 sizes the plan and refuses nothing for its size
    // Load the blob once with the device's builds before handing it back (exportPlan's comment). Off only for a test
    // that needs a blob the device refuses.
    bool          trialLoad = true;
};

struct ExportResult {
    std::vector<PlanError>    errors;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> blob;  // empty when errors is not
    PlanSize                  size;  // what the loader's sizing pass gives the blob with the device's builds
    bool                      ok() const { return errors.empty(); }
};

// Plans `document` with the planner for `options.target`, so every rule a desktop plan keeps applies (the wiring, the
// layouts, unique types, the heap and threads refusals), on a host of the exporter's own: its rp.host.devices/2 answers
// every acquire with null, and it has no resources, so a document that names one is refused ("resources are not
// exported to rp2350 yet"). Writes each node's settings from its parsed settings (rp.sdk.settings-json/1, then
// settingsToMsgpack), never the document's JSON, so the device's reader agrees with the desktop's by construction.
// Then runs the loader's own check and sizing pass (sizePlan) over the blob with `deviceTypes`, the device's builds of
// the types (on the desktop, the renamed device-mode objects: rp_register_device_mode_packages), so a type the device
// does not build, one that asks more alignment than the target gives, or a plan its arena cannot hold, is refused here
// as the device would refuse it; and then loads it, with the same builds on the exporter's host, and unloads it, so a
// create or activate only the device's build refuses fails the export too. What it cannot see is what only a real
// device answers: the box's own host interfaces, its links, its timing.
ExportResult exportPlan(const GraphDocument& document, const NodeRegistry& registry,
                        std::span<const rp_package* const> deviceTypes, const ExportOptions& options);
// The same, from the document's JSON ("document" refuses text that is not one, as GraphHost::setGraph does).
ExportResult exportPlan(std::string_view documentJson, const NodeRegistry& registry,
                        std::span<const rp_package* const> deviceTypes, const ExportOptions& options);

}  // namespace rp::graph
````

Create `packages/graph-runtime/native/src/graph/PlanExport.cpp`:

````cpp
#include "graph/PlanExport.hpp"

#include <atomic>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

#include "graph/CanonicalJson.hpp"
#include "graph/JsonToMsgpack.hpp"
#include "graph/PlanBlob.hpp"
#include "graph/PlanStorage.hpp"
#include "graph/ResourceTable.hpp"
#include "graph/node.hpp"
#include "graph/rp_device.h"

namespace rp::graph {

namespace {

using namespace blob;

constexpr const char* kNotExported = "resources are not exported to rp2350 yet";
// What the exporter's resource table answers a node whose settings name a resource; a create that fails with it is a
// "resource" refusal. The node's own words come first: `rom: "res:7" is named, and resources are ...`.
constexpr const char* kNamed = "is named, and resources are not exported to rp2350 yet";

// ---- the exporter's host --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Its devices interface answers every acquire with null, so a node that binds a device (rp.n8.nes) runs on its own
// disconnected stub, as in any host that owns no device; one that finds no devices interface at all refuses to
// activate, so the exporter offers this one rather than none. Its resource table holds nothing and says why.
void* acquireNoDevice(void*, const char*, const char*) { return nullptr; }
void  releaseNoDevice(void*, void*) {}
const rp_host_devices kDevices{nullptr, &acquireNoDevice, &releaseNoDevice};

const rp_resource* refuseResource(void*, std::uint32_t, const char*, rp_error* err) {
    if (err) std::snprintf(err->message, sizeof err->message, "%s", kNamed);
    return nullptr;
}
bool releaseNoResource(void*, std::uint32_t) { return false; }
const rp_host_resources kResources{nullptr, &refuseResource, &releaseNoResource};

void        ignoreLog(void*, int, const char*) {}
const void* hostInterface(const rp_host*, const char* id) {
    if (std::strcmp(id, RP_HOST_DEVICES_INTERFACE) == 0) return &kDevices;
    if (std::strcmp(id, RP_HOST_RESOURCES_INTERFACE) == 0) return &kResources;
    return nullptr;
}
const rp_host kHost{RP_ABI_VERSION, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, &ignoreLog, &hostInterface};

// ---- the plan, as records -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Writes a PlanStorage the planner built as the blob's records. Every pool is numbered in the planner's own order (its
// buffers, queues and streams as it made them, the instances' port states in the document's order, the feedback fronts
// in wire order), and every table follows the plan's own (its steps, its queues to clear, its adoption lists), so the
// bytes depend on the document and the types alone: the maps below are keyed by address for lookup, and never walked.
class Writer {
public:
    Writer(const PlanStorage& st, std::vector<PlanError>& errors) : st_(st), errors_(errors) {}

    bool write(const ExportOptions& options, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) {
        numberPools();
        if (!nodes() || !steps() || !afterBlock() || !atAdoption()) return false;
        assemble(options, out);
        return true;
    }

private:
    struct Run {
        std::uint32_t offset = 0;
        std::uint32_t count = 0;
    };

    const PlanStorage&                                   st_;
    std::vector<PlanError>&                              errors_;
    std::map<const rp_node*, std::uint32_t>              nodeIndex_;
    std::map<const std::atomic<std::uint32_t>*, std::uint32_t> dropsIndex_;
    std::map<const float*, std::uint32_t>                buffers_;
    std::map<float* const*, Run>                         channelRuns_;
    std::map<const rp_queue*, std::uint32_t>             queueIndex_;
    std::map<const rp_control_queue*, std::uint32_t>     streamIndex_;
    std::map<rp_resource* const*, std::uint32_t>         cellIndex_;
    std::map<std::string, Bytes>                         stringAt_;

    std::vector<std::uint8_t>     strings_, settings_, maskBytes_;
    std::vector<NodeRecord>       nodes_;
    std::vector<StepRecord>       steps_;
    std::vector<ViewRecord>       views_;
    std::vector<ParamViewRecord>  paramViews_;
    std::vector<std::uint32_t>    channels_, rolls_, peerNodes_;
    std::vector<QueueRecord>      queues_;
    std::vector<StreamRecord>     streams_;
    std::vector<ClearRecord>      clears_;
    std::vector<FeedbackRecord>   feedback_;
    std::vector<MaskRecord>       masks_;
    std::vector<PeerRecord>       peers_;
    std::vector<ParamStartRecord> paramStarts_;

    bool internal(const std::string& what) {
        errors_.push_back({"", "", "export-internal", "the planned plan cannot be written: " + what});
        return false;
    }

    // ---- pools ----

    void addBuffer(const float* b) { buffers_.emplace(b, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(buffers_.size())); }
    void addQueue(const rp_queue& q) {
        if (queueIndex_.emplace(&q, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(queues_.size())).second)
            queues_.push_back({q.capacity, q.bytes_capacity});
    }
    void addStream(const rp_control_queue& q) {
        if (!streamIndex_.emplace(&q, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(streams_.size())).second) return;
        StreamRecord r{q.capacity, {}};
        splitDouble(q.start, r.start);
        streams_.push_back(r);
    }

    void numberPools() {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < st_.instances.size(); ++i) {
            nodeIndex_[st_.instances[i]->node] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
            dropsIndex_[&st_.instances[i]->drops] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
        }
        addBuffer(st_.silence.get());
        addBuffer(st_.scratch.get());
        for (const auto& a : st_.audio) addBuffer(a.get());
        addQueue(st_.emptyQueue->queue);
        addQueue(st_.scratchQueue->queue);
        for (const auto& q : st_.queues) addQueue(q->queue);
        addStream(st_.emptyStream->queue);
        for (const auto& ports : st_.ports) {
            for (const auto& p : ports->params) addStream(p->queue);
            for (const auto& c : ports->controlOutputs)
                if (c) addStream(c->queue);
        }
        for (const auto& f : st_.feedbackFronts) {
            for (float* channel : f->pointers) addBuffer(channel);
            if (f->queue) addQueue(f->queue->queue);
            if (f->stream) addStream(f->stream->queue);
        }
    }

    bool channelRun(float* const* channels, std::uint32_t count, std::uint32_t* offset) {
        const auto it = channelRuns_.find(channels);
        if (it != channelRuns_.end()) {
            if (count > it->second.count) return internal("one channel array is read at two widths");
            *offset = it->second.offset;
            return true;
        }
        const Run run{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(channels_.size()), count};
        for (std::uint32_t c = 0; c < count; ++c) {
            const auto b = buffers_.find(channels[c]);
            if (b == buffers_.end()) return internal("an audio channel is no buffer of the plan's");
            channels_.push_back(b->second);
        }
        channelRuns_.emplace(channels, run);
        *offset = run.offset;
        return true;
    }
    bool queue(const rp_queue* q, std::uint32_t* index) {
        const auto it = queueIndex_.find(q);
        if (it == queueIndex_.end()) return internal("a queue is none of the plan's");
        *index = it->second;
        return true;
    }
    bool stream(const rp_control_queue* q, std::uint32_t* index) {
        const auto it = streamIndex_.find(q);
        if (it == streamIndex_.end()) return internal("a control stream is none of the plan's");
        *index = it->second;
        return true;
    }
    bool node(const rp_node* n, std::uint32_t* index) {
        const auto it = nodeIndex_.find(n);
        if (it == nodeIndex_.end()) return internal("a node is none of the plan's instances");
        *index = it->second;
        return true;
    }

    bool view(const rp_port_view& v, ViewRecord& r) {
        r = ViewRecord{v.kind, 0, 0};
        switch (v.kind) {
            case RP_PORT_AUDIO:
                r.count = v.u.audio.channel_count;
                return channelRun(v.u.audio.channels, r.count, &r.index);
            case RP_PORT_EVENTS:
            case RP_PORT_BYTES: return queue(v.u.queue, &r.index);
            case RP_PORT_CONTROL: return stream(v.u.control, &r.index);
            case RP_PORT_RESOURCE:
                // A cell a resource wire shares, or an unbound input's: either holds null in an exported plan, since a
                // resource is refused before planning and no node has run to write one.
                if (*v.u.resource) return internal("a resource slot holds a resource");
                r.index = cellIndex_.emplace(v.u.resource, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cellIndex_.size())).first->second;
                return true;
            case RP_PORT_LINK: return true;
            default: return internal("a port has kind " + std::to_string(v.kind));
        }
    }

    // ---- tables ----

    Bytes string(const std::string& s) {
        const auto it = stringAt_.find(s);
        if (it != stringAt_.end()) return it->second;
        const Bytes b{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(strings_.size()), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s.size())};
        strings_.insert(strings_.end(), s.begin(), s.end());
        stringAt_.emplace(s, b);
        return b;
    }

    // Each instance's settings as it parsed them (rp.sdk.settings-json/1), as msgpack.
    bool settingsOf(const Instance& inst, Bytes& out) {
        const auto* writer =
            static_cast<const SettingsJsonInterface*>(inst.node->vt->get_interface(inst.node, kSettingsJsonInterface));
        if (!writer) {
            errors_.push_back({inst.id, "", "settings-export",
                               "node type " + jsonString(inst.entry->descriptor.id) +
                                   " cannot write its settings back (" + kSettingsJsonInterface +
                                   "), so it cannot be exported"});
            return false;
        }
        std::string json(256, '\0');
        std::size_t n = writer->write(inst.node, json.data(), json.size());
        if (n >= json.size()) {
            json.assign(n + 1, '\0');
            n = writer->write(inst.node, json.data(), json.size());
        }
        if (n == 0 || n >= json.size()) {
            errors_.push_back({inst.id, "", "settings-export", "the node could not write its settings back"});
            return false;
        }
        json.resize(n);
        auto bytes = settingsToMsgpack(json);
        if (!bytes) {
            errors_.push_back({inst.id, "", "settings-export", bytes.error().what()});
            return false;
        }
        out = Bytes{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(settings_.size()), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(bytes->size())};
        settings_.insert(settings_.end(), bytes->begin(), bytes->end());
        return true;
    }

    bool nodes() {
        for (const auto& inst : st_.instances) {
            NodeRecord r{};
            r.id = string(inst->id);
            r.type = string(inst->entry->descriptor.id);
            if (!settingsOf(*inst, r.settings)) return false;
            nodes_.push_back(r);
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool steps() {
        std::uint32_t group = 0, groupEnd = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < st_.steps.size(); ++i) {
            const PlanStep& s = st_.steps[i];
            StepRecord r{};
            if (!node(s.node, &r.node)) return false;
            r.groupSize = s.groupSize;
            // A coupled group is one group however many steps it takes; every other step is a group of its own.
            if (i >= groupEnd) {
                if (i > 0) ++group;
                groupEnd = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i) + (s.groupSize > 1 ? s.groupSize : 1);
            }
            nodes_[r.node].group = group;
            nodes_[r.node].step = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(i);
            r.firstInput = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(views_.size());
            r.inputCount = s.process.input_count;
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < s.process.input_count; ++k) {
                ViewRecord v;
                if (!view(s.process.inputs[k], v)) return false;
                views_.push_back(v);
            }
            r.firstOutput = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(views_.size());
            r.outputCount = s.process.output_count;
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < s.process.output_count; ++k) {
                ViewRecord v;
                if (!view(s.process.outputs[k], v)) return false;
                views_.push_back(v);
            }
            r.firstParam = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(paramViews_.size());
            r.paramCount = s.process.param_count;
            const PortState& ports = *st_.ports[r.node];
            if (ports.params.size() != s.process.param_count) return internal("a step's params are not its node's");
            for (std::uint32_t k = 0; k < s.process.param_count; ++k) {
                // A param reads its own stream unless a wire drives it, when it reads the wire's source instead.
                ParamViewRecord v{0, s.process.params[k] != &ports.params[k]->queue ? 1u : 0u};
                if (!stream(s.process.params[k], &v.stream)) return false;
                paramViews_.push_back(v);
            }
            steps_.push_back(r);
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool afterBlock() {
        for (const OutputQueue& o : st_.queuesToClear) {
            ClearRecord r{0, kNoNode};
            if (!queue(o.queue, &r.queue)) return false;
            if (o.drops) {
                const auto it = dropsIndex_.find(o.drops);
                if (it == dropsIndex_.end()) return internal("a queue's drops are charged to no instance");
                r.node = it->second;
            }
            clears_.push_back(r);
        }
        for (const rp_control_queue* c : st_.controlsToRoll) {
            std::uint32_t index = 0;
            if (!stream(c, &index)) return false;
            rolls_.push_back(index);
        }
        for (const FeedbackCopy& f : st_.feedback) {
            FeedbackRecord r{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(f.kind), 0, 0, 0, 0};
            bool ok = true;
            if (f.kind == RP_PORT_AUDIO) {
                r.channels = f.channels;
                r.frames = f.capacity;
                ok = channelRun(f.backChannels, f.channels, &r.back) &&
                     channelRun(f.frontChannels, f.channels, &r.front);
            } else if (f.kind == RP_PORT_CONTROL) {
                ok = stream(f.backControl, &r.back) && stream(f.frontControl, &r.front);
            } else {
                ok = queue(f.backQueue, &r.back) && queue(f.frontQueue, &r.front);
            }
            if (!ok) return false;
            feedback_.push_back(r);
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool atAdoption() {
        if (!st_.commits.empty()) return internal("a fresh plan commits settings");
        for (const auto& p : st_.peers) {
            PeerRecord r{0, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(peerNodes_.size()), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p.peers.size())};
            if (!node(p.node, &r.node)) return false;
            for (const rp_node* peer : p.peers) {
                std::uint32_t index = 0;
                if (!node(peer, &index)) return false;
                peerNodes_.push_back(index);
            }
            peers_.push_back(r);
        }
        for (const auto& p : st_.portsChanged) {
            MaskRecord r{0, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(maskBytes_.size()), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(p.mask.size())};
            if (!node(p.node, &r.node)) return false;
            maskBytes_.insert(maskBytes_.end(), p.mask.begin(), p.mask.end());
            masks_.push_back(r);
        }
        for (const auto& s : st_.paramSets) {
            ParamStartRecord r{};
            if (!stream(s.queue, &r.stream)) return false;
            splitDouble(s.value, r.value);
            paramStarts_.push_back(r);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // ---- the bytes ----

    template <class T>
    static void append(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out, const T* data, std::size_t count) {
        const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(data);
        out.insert(out.end(), p, p + count * sizeof(T));
        while (out.size() % 4) out.push_back(0);
    }

    void assemble(const ExportOptions& options, std::vector<std::uint8_t>& out) {
        Header h{};
        std::memcpy(h.magic, kMagic, sizeof kMagic);
        h.version = kVersion;
        h.target = kTargetRp2350;
        splitDouble(options.sampleRate, h.sampleRate);
        h.maxFrames = options.maxFrames;
        h.arenaBytes = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(options.arenaBytes);
        h.buffers = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(buffers_.size());
        h.cells = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cellIndex_.size());
        h.sectionCount = kSectionCount;
        out.assign(sizeof(Header), 0);
        auto section = [&](Section s, const auto& records) {
            SectionEntry& e = h.sections[static_cast<std::uint32_t>(s)];
            e.offset = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out.size());
            e.count = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(records.size());
            e.recordBytes = recordBytes(s);
            append(out, records.data(), records.size());
        };
        section(Section::Strings, strings_);
        section(Section::Settings, settings_);
        section(Section::Nodes, nodes_);
        section(Section::Steps, steps_);
        section(Section::Views, views_);
        section(Section::ParamViews, paramViews_);
        section(Section::Channels, channels_);
        section(Section::Queues, queues_);
        section(Section::Streams, streams_);
        section(Section::Clears, clears_);
        section(Section::Rolls, rolls_);
        section(Section::Feedback, feedback_);
        section(Section::Masks, masks_);
        section(Section::MaskBytes, maskBytes_);
        section(Section::Peers, peers_);
        section(Section::PeerNodes, peerNodes_);
        section(Section::ParamStarts, paramStarts_);
        h.size = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(out.size() + sizeof(std::uint32_t));
        std::memcpy(out.data(), &h, sizeof h);
        const std::uint32_t crc = crc32(out.data(), out.size());
        append(out, &crc, 1);
    }
};

std::string text(const char* s, std::size_t capacity) {
    std::size_t n = 0;
    while (n < capacity && s[n]) ++n;
    return std::string(s, n);
}

}  // namespace

ExportResult exportPlan(const GraphDocument& document, const NodeRegistry& registry,
                        std::span<const rp_package* const> deviceTypes, const ExportOptions& options) {
    ExportResult result;
    if (options.target != Target::Pico) {
        result.errors.push_back({"", "", "target", std::string("a plan is exported for ") + kTargetName + " alone"});
        return result;
    }
    if (options.maxFrames == 0 || !std::isfinite(options.sampleRate) || options.sampleRate <= 0.0) {
        result.errors.push_back({"", "", "export-options", "a plan's sample rate and maxFrames must be positive"});
        return result;
    }
    if (options.arenaBytes > 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
        result.errors.push_back({"", "", "export-options", "an arena of 4 GiB or more is no device's"});
        return result;
    }
    // A binding names a resource outright; a settings field that names one is refused at create, by the host's table.
    for (const auto& n : document.nodes)
        if (n.resources)
            for (const auto& binding : *n.resources)
                result.errors.push_back({n.id, binding.first, "resource", kNotExported});
    if (!result.errors.empty()) return result;

    ResourceTable                                         resources;
    const std::map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<Instance>>      live;
    const std::map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<FeedbackFront>> fronts;
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t>                            faults{0}, drops{0};
    PlanInput in;
    in.doc = &document;
    in.registry = &registry;
    in.resources = &resources;
    in.live = &live;
    in.feedback = &fronts;
    in.host = &kHost;
    in.sampleRate = options.sampleRate;
    in.maxFrames = options.maxFrames;
    in.target = options.target;
    in.faults = &faults;
    in.drops = &drops;
    PlanOutcome planned = plan(in);
    for (auto& e : planned.errors) {
        if (e.code == "create-failed" && e.message.find(kNamed) != std::string::npos) e.code = "resource";
        result.errors.push_back(std::move(e));
    }
    if (!result.errors.empty()) return result;

    std::vector<std::uint8_t> blob;
    if (!Writer(*planned.storage, result.errors).write(options, blob)) return result;
    PlanLoadError err{};
    auto refuse = [&] {
        result.errors.push_back({text(err.node, sizeof err.node), "", text(err.code, sizeof err.code),
                                 text(err.message, sizeof err.message)});
        return result;
    };
    if (!sizePlan(blob, deviceTypes, options.arenaBytes, &result.size, &err)) return refuse();
    // The trial load: the blob laid out, created and activated by the device's builds on the exporter's host, in an
    // arena of exactly the size it measured, then unloaded. What the device's create or activate would refuse at boot
    // (a refusal a device build makes and the desktop's does not) is refused here instead, in the loader's words.
    if (options.trialLoad) {
        std::vector<std::max_align_t> arena(result.size.bytes / sizeof(std::max_align_t) + 1);
        LoadedPlan* loaded = loadPlan(blob, std::span<std::byte>(reinterpret_cast<std::byte*>(arena.data()),
                                                                 result.size.bytes),
                                      deviceTypes, &kHost, &err);
        if (!loaded) return refuse();
        unloadPlan(loaded);
    }
    result.blob = std::move(blob);
    return result;
}

ExportResult exportPlan(std::string_view documentJson, const NodeRegistry& registry,
                        std::span<const rp_package* const> deviceTypes, const ExportOptions& options) {
    auto doc = parseGraphDocument(documentJson);
    if (!doc) {
        ExportResult r;
        r.errors.push_back({"", "", "document", std::string("not a graph document: ") + doc.error().what()});
        return r;
    }
    return exportPlan(*doc, registry, deviceTypes, options);
}

}  // namespace rp::graph
````

````cmake
# retroplug-export-plan (main.cpp): the plan exporter's build-time tool (docs/modular-graph-phase-e3-design.md section
# 4). A device image's build runs it over the image's plan.json and embeds the header it writes, so a plan the device
# cannot run, or one its arena cannot hold, fails the firmware's build rather than its boot. The root CMakeLists adds
# this directory once the packages it lists are added.
#
# A device product of the desktop build (cmake/packages.cmake), so it registers the device entries of the packages it
# lists as the desktop builds them, which plan; beside them, the same entries as the device builds them
# (retroplug_device_mode_objects), which the loader's sizing pass sizes the plan with. Not shipped, and built by name:
# the scripts that build a device image build it first, and retroplug-device-mode-test runs it.
set(RP_EXPORT_PLAN_PACKAGES core dsp n8)
add_executable(retroplug-export-plan EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp)
set_target_properties(retroplug-export-plan PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
retroplug_product(retroplug-export-plan PACKAGES ${RP_EXPORT_PLAN_PACKAGES} DEVICE)
retroplug_device_mode_objects(retroplug-export-plan-device PACKAGES ${RP_EXPORT_PLAN_PACKAGES})
target_sources(retroplug-export-plan PRIVATE $<TARGET_OBJECTS:retroplug-export-plan-device>)
target_link_libraries(retroplug-export-plan PRIVATE retroplug-graph retroplug-node-sdk)
````
